taxReceiptNotice.text: LDII is a Canadian nonprofit organization, not a registered charity, so gifts are not eligible for a charitable tax receipt. We acknowledge every gift by email.

whyDonateSection.heading: Why Your Donation Matters
whyDonateSection.text: Your gift goes to LDII’s local programmes in Ontario: newcomers, youth and seniors.
whyDonateSection.text2: Ask us at any time how your gift was used. Annual reports will be published on our Impact page.
whyDonateSection.text3: Your gift supports our conferences, exchanges and youth and community programmes.

securityNotice.label: Your information
securityNotice.text: This form sends your pledge to our team by email. It does not take card details, and we never share your information with third parties.
